title: nonux Component Interface Definition Language (IDL)
description: Per-interface IDL file at interfaces/idl/<iface>.json. Consumed by tools/gen-iface.py to emit message structs, ops typedef, sender wrappers, and receiver dispatch templates. Schema spec lives at proj_docs/nonux/IDL-SCHEMA.md (locked Session 80; landing in slice 8.0pre.1).

interface.description: Interface identifier; must match the JSON filename stem.

version.description: Bumped on breaking changes (op signature change, removed op, type change).

doc.description: Optional; copied verbatim into the generated header banner comment.

forward_decls_doc.description: Optional block-comment text emitted above the auto-detected forward declarations. The set of forward declarations (struct/union/enum types referenced by op params via 'ctype' but not defined inline) is derived automatically by the generator; this field provides only the leading prose.

includes.description: Additional headers to #include in the generated typedef header (above and beyond <stddef.h>/<stdint.h> which are always included). Forward extension to the spec; supports interfaces whose ops reference external types (e.g. vfs uses struct nx_fs_dirent from interfaces/fs.h).

constants.description: Public #define constants emitted at the top of the typedef header. Forward extension to the spec; preserves API surface (e.g. NX_VFS_OPEN_READ) when the hand-written header is replaced by the generator output.

ops.description: Ordered op records. op_id values are stable across versions; removed ops leave a gravestone.

path.description: Header path; quoted with '<...>' if system is true, else '"..."'.

system.description: True for <system> includes, false for "local" includes. Default: false.

doc.description: Optional; copied as a trailing comment on the include line.

value.description: Numeric or string literal; emitted verbatim after the macro name. Strings are emitted as-is (no quoting); pass already-quoted forms for string macros.

doc.description: Optional; copied as a leading-line comment above the #define.

name.description: Op identifier; matches a C function-pointer field name in struct nx_<iface>_ops.

op_id.description: Stable; never reused. Removed ops leave a gravestone.

doc.description: Optional; copied verbatim into generated comments above the op declaration.

context.description: Execution context. 'irq' ops emit a fixed-size pre-built pool and an ISR enqueue helper; reserved for slice 8.0pre.3's char_device work.

pause_policy.description: Per-op override of the slot's pause policy. v1 ignores any non-null value (reserved-only).

trace_tag.description: Optional override for the default trace tag (default: <iface>_<name>).

params.description: Ordered, named params. May be empty.

direction.description: Drives copy-in/copy-out behavior in the wrapper and dispatch template.

len.description: For bytes_in: name of the param holding the length.

cap.description: For bytes_out: name of the param holding the buffer cap.

ctype.description: For struct_in/_out/_inout: verbatim C type name (e.g. 'struct nx_fs_stat', 'uint32_t').

max_len.description: For string_in: per-param ceiling on length (NUL excluded). Generator caps at this value.

out_param.description: Optional; names the param carrying principal output (the param itself must have direction: 'out' or 'inout').
